encoding: 8-bit grayscale, value = percent (whole, 0-100; 255 = no data); top PNG row = highest y
rowOrder: top PNG row = highest y, left column = lowest x; grid cell (iy, ix) is pixel (column ix, row ny - 1 - iy)
resampling: mean of 16x16 bilinear samples per cell (area average, not a site value)
source: NASA PGDA product 69 (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/69), average visibility 75S 120 m 2016-08
definition: Fraction of time any part of the Sun/Earth disk is visible (PGDA label wording); differs from our mean Sun fraction / Earth-center validation definitions.
observerHeightNote: Not stated in the PGDA product page, labels or README; tracked in #57. Do not assume a height.
